caption: This pencil drawing on a cream-colored background depicts a single object, identified as a pair of tongs, positioned horizontally with the gripping ends oriented to the left. The tongs are rendered in shades of gray, with careful shading providing a three-dimensional appearance. Each arm of the tongs culminates in an ornate, rounded end that resembles a fluted or scalloped shell. The handles are decorated, with one side bearing an engraved design that appears to be a classical urn surrounded by flowing leaves. On the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's name, "Walton Kalamian," is neatly inscribed. The sheet shows some slight discoloration and foxing around the edges, particularly in the upper corners. The background remains otherwise clear and plain, with no additional objects or embellishments.
title: Silver Sugar Tongs
